Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.core.location

Class ElementLocator.Element

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.core.location.ElementLocator.Element
Enclosing interface:
ElementLocator
public static class ElementLocator.Element extends Object
Result of an element location operation. This lightweight class contains the found element without action-specific semantics.
